answer.reason: Louisiana's electricity mix is dominated by independent power producers and industrial combined-heat-and-power (cogeneration) units serving its large petrochemical, refining, and LNG industries. In the EIA Louisiana Electricity Profile, the IPP & CHP net generation figure is on the order of 65 million MWh — the largest share of the state's roughly 100 million MWh total — while the electric utilities' generation is about 34.7 million MWh (option A corresponds to the utilities line, not IPP & CHP). Thus, 64,884,441 MWh is the IPP & CHP value, consistent with the supplied draft answer.

Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Louisiana Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 34,738,394 megawatthours
B. 64,884,441 megawatthours

Source citation: Louisiana Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/louisiana/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: B
